titulo: Step 4: social media on autopilot, with the source on screen
lead: r7e builds the reel in seven trigger-based stages. promoavatar makes avatar videos for each audience. The xviral tools watch what the biggest channels in the niche have published, check every number, and publish with the source on screen. The engine is the same: only the topic changes.
objetivo: design a channel for your niche with rules, a sourced base, a checked script, a schedule, and a gate before publishing.

aprende.t: The base with a literal source

secoes.titulo: The pipeline of a channel with a source
secoes.sub: This is what finviral, saudeviral, and advviral do on their own.

nos.detalhe: The biggest channels in your niche and the rules: what counts as a fact, the required notice, and what you never publish.
From the transcript, each number goes in with who said it, the video, and the literal excerpt. You check each excerpt against the transcript.

nos.sub: 60 s with the source on screen
nos.detalhe: The agent writes the script using only what is in the base. A number that isn't in the base? The script goes back.
Before publishing, you approve. Each rejection becomes a new rule in regras.md.

itens.t: A weak day doesn't become a video
A failure alerts you on Telegram

nos.detalhe: You decide how often (e.g., Monday to Friday in the early morning and a long one on Saturday). A day with no topic doesn't become a video, and a failure alerts you on Telegram.

secoes.volta: Every refusal at the gate becomes a new rule
secoes.legenda: Without a queue and a gate, automating social media just means posting the wrong thing faster.

rolagem_fim.texto: References and rules feed the base with a source; the base limits the script; the gate decides what goes out; the schedule posts only on days with a topic. Every refusal becomes a new rule.

secoes.sub: Click each step. Illustrative example for the real estate niche.

abas.html:
Every number in the script has to be in base.md, with the literal excerpt found in the transcript. If any number is missing, the script goes back.

That is exactly what finviral's checar.py does on its own.

• r7e: a 7-step reel with quality gates.
  • promoavatar: one video per audience, 12 audiences, with a gate in the middle.
  • promoavatar3: reach, authority, and promotional for the same audience.
  • finviral, saudeviral, advviral: the same engine for finance, health, and law.

exercicios.titulo: E1 · A reel in 7 steps, on paper
exercicios.texto: Write a 30 to 45 second reel for your niche using the r7e model.
exercicios.pronto: you can read it aloud in under 45 s and the first sentence already states the benefit.

exercicios.texto: Pick 5 reference channels and write the rules for your niche.
exercicios.pronto: you have canais.md and regras.md for your niche.

exercicios.titulo: E3 · The base with a source
exercicios.texto: Transcribe a reference video and build base.md with the number, who said it, the video and the exact excerpt.
exercicios.pronto: each line has the exact excerpt and you found each one in the transcript.

exercicios.titulo: E4 · A 60 s script with the source on screen
exercicios.texto: Ask the agent for a script based on the base: the strongest number, three facts with who said them, a warning and an invitation.
exercicios.pronto: every number in the script is in base.md.

exercicios.texto: Decide how often to post and write the schedule (cron or systemd timer).
exercicios.pronto: the schedule is written and you know what happens on a day with no topic.

exercicios.texto: Run for one week with manual approval and write down each rejection as a rule.
exercicios.pronto: you went 3 days in a row without having to reject anything.

perguntas.p: The script has a number that is not in base.md. What do you do?
opcoes: Publish it, if the number looks right.
Replace it with a rounded number.
Send the script back: every number must be in the base, with the exact excerpt.
Remove the source from the screen.
perguntas.explica: The E4 rule: every number in the script is in base.md. If it isn't, the script goes back.

perguntas.p: What is the first sentence of an r7e reel?
opcoes: The benefit, the result in 2 seconds.
perguntas.explica: The hook is the result in 2 seconds. The name of the solution only appears in step 5 (discovery).

perguntas.p: When is it reasonable to remove the gate from a step?
opcoes: In the first week, to save time.
Never, the gate is mandatory for everything.
After a few days in a row without having to reject anything.
When the channel passes a thousand subscribers.
perguntas.explica: E6 asks for three days in a row without a rejection. Only then think about removing the gate from a step.
